entries.failure_short: Profiler broke on 2.11 due to PT 2.11 changes + parallel runtime changes.
entries.remediation_short: Deferred to 2.12 upgrade (new PrivateUse1 profiler API).

entries.failure_short: s390x / ppc64le runners not available at 2.11 merge; x86 alone gated merge after #1997 landed.
size_hint removed, split into optimization_hint (may be non-concrete) and guarding_hint_or_throw (concrete or throws). Wrong choice = silent wrong SDSC compilation.
entries.remediation_short: Use guarding_hint_or_throw where concretization is required.

entries.failure_short: PT 2.12 added in-tree decomps for arange/tril/triu/isin/index_copy.out and broadened mm/bmm to decompose the K==1 case; torch-spyre's fallbacks conflict with the auto-installed decomp.
Dynamo graph-breaks when inlining spyre_to's C++ orig_to call; D2D dtype casts silently go eager and return wrong results.
PT 2.12 changed CPU-reference fp16 numerics for exp/sin round-trips; 1-ULP drifts fail existing assertions.
entries.remediation_short: xfail the three edge cases via commit 3a2d482.

entries.failure_short: Upstream vLLM had NOT moved to 2.12 at merge time.
entries.remediation_short: spyre-inference#357 removed dep on precompiled vLLM CPU wheels.

entries.status: landed; forward-compat skill produced a byte-identical fix in independent replay.

entries.failure_short: PT 2.13 Scheduler._try_reorder_loops_for_candidates computes then DISCARDS a loop reorder. LX-pinned clones no longer accidentally match consumers' iter order. Two reductions sharing one LX buffer read the wrong core's slice. Silent wrong results.
entries.remediation_short: New align_lx_producer_loop_order pass, run BEFORE build_loop_scheduler_nodes.
entries.notes: 'accidental correctness' had held since forever; only surfaced when the upstream internal rewrite stopped applying.

entries.failure_short: torch._import_device_backends() fires while torch_spyre is partially initialized. `_autoload` name not yet bound; AttributeError → wrapped RuntimeError.
entries.remediation_short: Hoist a defer-and-invoke `def _autoload()` before `import torch`; tail-invoke at end of file.
